name: Set Up Window for Painting
intent: Floor protection at window base, glass mask the panes, protect hardware (latches, locks, balances), mask the adjacent wall, protect the sill (spray only). Per-window setup is more involved than per-door setup because windows have glass that must not get painted on.
doctrine: Glass masking (60 SF/hr) is the slow part of window setup — taping glass cleanly without leaving residue requires careful work. Sill protection only fires for spray methods because brush work doesn't drip onto sills. Height modifier matters for tall windows on a ladder.
